title: Python: duty cycle TX queue gating
description: Duty cycle integration with TX queue. AC: TX queue respects duty cycle budget before transmitting.
close_reason: Deferred: Needs design decision. The TX queue currently has no duty cycle integration. The DutyCycleTracker exists in lora_medium and is enforced at the simulator layer (node_server.py), but the TX queue/link layer have no awareness of duty cycle budget. Implementing 'TX queue respects duty cycle budget' requires design decisions: (1) where enforcement belongs (TX queue vs link layer vs both), (2) behavior when exhausted (block/fail/delay), (3) how duty tracker is injected. This is feature work, not a bug fix.
